handyMigration.quitHandy:
Handy is still running, so Legato can't bring over your settings and history yet.

Quit Handy from its tray icon, then choose Retry. If you choose Cancel, Legato starts without them and won't ask again. They stay in Handy's folder.
handyMigration.filesInUse:
Something still has files open in Handy's folder, so Legato can't bring over your settings and history yet.

Close any program that might be using them, then choose Retry. If you choose Cancel, Legato starts without them and won't ask again. They stay in Handy's folder.
handyMigration.uninstallHandy:
Your settings, history and recordings are now in Legato.

Uninstall Handy so the two apps don't both run and fight over the same shortcut. Open Windows Settings to uninstall it?

try.title: Try with your words
try.placeholder: Type a sentence as you'd say it

method.title: Paste with
method.help: How the text gets into the app. Terminals and some editors want Shift+Insert.

after.title: After pasting
after.help: Press a key once the text is in, for example Enter to send a chat message.

space.title: Trailing space
space.help: Keeps the next dictation from running into this one. Inherit is {{value}}, from Settings › Output.

edit.title: Apps for {{category}}
edit.description: Choose which apps and websites use this style. Changes save as you go.
edit.emptyHere: No apps here yet. Move one from the list below, add a website, or pick a window.
edit.siteHelp: Text in the browser tab's title, such as Linear or Jira.
edit.pickHelp_one: Click it, then switch to the app within {{count}} second.
edit.pickHelp_other: Click it, then switch to the app within {{count}} seconds.
edit.pickMissed: No other app came to the front. Try again.
edit.emptyOthers: Apps you dictate into show up here.

scratchpad.title: Scratchpad
scratchpad.subtitle: A floating note you can type or dictate into instead of the app in front.
scratchpad.subtitleFailedOn: Pastes that fail are saved here and the window opens.
scratchpad.subtitleFailedOff: Pastes that fail are saved here without opening the window.
scratchpad.noResultsBody: Search looks at titles and at the text inside each note.

empty.title: No notes yet
empty.body: Start a note here, or hold {{keys}} in any app to dictate one.
empty.bodyNoKey: Start a note here, or set a shortcut to open the Scratchpad from any app.

emptyPinned.title: No pinned notes
emptyPinned.body: Pin the notes you come back to. With When opened set to Last pinned note, the shortcut opens them first.

scratchpad.footer: {{notes}} · {{pinned}} pinned · kept on this PC until you delete them

card.title: Note title
card.placeholder: Start typing, or open the window to dictate

editor.label: Note text
editor.placeholder: Start typing, or press Ctrl+Space to dictate

versions.title: Version history
versions.description: A version is kept each time the note is saved, up to 50.

keepOnTop.title: Keep on top of other windows
keepOnTop.help: The window floats above other apps until you close it, so you can read or dictate into it while you work.

window.noTarget: Click into the app you want the text in, then open the Scratchpad
window.emptyBody: Start a new note, or open one from the Scratchpad page in Legato.
